highlights: The Green Lion Ultimate Smart Watch emerges as a groundbreaking development in the smartwatch realm, combining a multitude of advanced functionalities.

It comes equipped with a resilient 250 mAh battery, capable of providing up to 10 days of continuous use, and features a comprehensive suite of health monitoring sensors, including ECG, sleep tracking, blood oxygen, and heart rate monitoring, all aimed at addressing your health monitoring needs.
The watch's intuitive interface includes a double-tap feature and an always-on display, along with Bluetooth calling capabilities for improved connectivity.
Enhancing its functionality, it houses various applications such as a calculator, games, and ChatGPT, and facilitates the effortless reception of notifications.
Moreover, its robust construction complies with the IPX67 standard, ensuring both durability and protection against environmental elements.
